auth.identities.note: Own provider names and dates; no provider identifiers or identity JSON.

auth.users.note: Own allowlisted account fields only; no passwords, tokens or raw metadata.

public.account_deletion_log.excluded: Deletion fence and security retention record; manual privacy review, not a self-service payload.

public.account_sanctions.excluded: Private administrative evidence journal with third-party inventory snapshots; requires separate manual privacy review. Own published receipt summaries are available through the dedicated authenticated reader.

public.achievements.excluded: Global achievement definitions; own completion history comes from user_achievements.

public.active_binder_aliases.excluded: Private catalogue-only alias projection; no player records.

public.active_binder_aliases_unmerged.excluded: Private catalogue-only aliases before editorial grouping; contains no player records or preferences.

public.admin_audit_logs.excluded: Security audit with third-party snapshots; requires separate manual privacy review.

public.admin_users.note: Own administrator boolean only; grantor and internal timestamps excluded.

public.anilist_import_review.excluded: Global catalogue import review queue keyed by catalogue card, not by player; contains no account preferences.

public.anime_license_aliases.excluded: Global verified license search aliases; no player records.

public.anime_license_binders.excluded: Global confirmed-license binder identities; no player records.

public.anime_license_key_redirects.excluded: Global redirects of historical binder keys; no player records.

public.anime_license_media_rules.excluded: Global verified media routing and explicit editorial exceptions; no player records.

public.anime_license_source_rules.excluded: Global confirmed source-license routing; no player records.

public.anime_series_aliases.excluded: Verified global catalogue search aliases; not an individual player record.

public.anime_series_binders.excluded: Global editorial binder definitions; not an individual account record.

public.anime_series_card_assignments.excluded: Global catalogue card-to-media provenance assignments; contains no ownership or player preferences.

public.anime_series_media_rules.excluded: Global editorial media-to-binder rules; contains no individual player data.

public.anime_series_origin_evidence.excluded: Private catalogue import evidence and card snapshots; keyed by catalogue character/card, never by player.

public.anime_series_protected_cards.excluded: Global catalogue provenance exclusions protecting source records; display grouping follows the separately approved license policy. No ownership or player preferences.

public.anime_series_settings.excluded: Global catalogue feature flag and mapping version; not an individual account record.

public.auction_chat_messages.note: Only messages authored by the requesting player.

public.auctions.note: Own involvement only; counterparties reduced to existing public presentation.

public.billing_accounts.excluded: Provider linkage, anti-fraud holds and operational leases require manual privacy review; never export nonces or lease tokens.

public.billing_entitlement_config.excluded: Global provider configuration; not an individual account record.

public.billing_request_limits.excluded: Transient anti-abuse counters; manual privacy review rather than exposing billing scopes.

public.billing_webhook_events.excluded: Provider event deduplication and security records; manual privacy review.

public.card_franchises.note: Only catalogue references associated with the requesting player.

public.card_reports.note: Own submissions only; internal moderation snapshots and status excluded.

public.card_share_creations.excluded: Share anti-abuse history; manual privacy review, no share capabilities.

public.card_shares.note: Own projection; link tokens and share URLs excluded.

public.cards.note: Referenced cards only, not a dump of the global catalogue.

public.catalogue_binder_group_merges.excluded: Global redirects and indexed catalogue source metadata for editorial binder merges; no player records or preferences.

public.catalogue_binder_groups.excluded: Global editorial binder identities and activation flags; contains no player records or preferences.

public.catalogue_binder_links.excluded: Private computed catalogue membership view; contains no player identity, ownership or preferences.

public.catalogue_binder_links_unmerged.excluded: Private source/provenance catalogue projection before editorial grouping; no player identity, ownership or preferences.

public.catalogue_binder_source_merges.excluded: Global exact category/source-license editorial mapping; no player records or preferences.

public.data_export_state.excluded: Transient export reservation and receipt state; never expose request capabilities.

public.friend_request_events.note: Only the requesting sender's recent sent/closed events, dates and recipient pseudo; no third-party UUIDs or another sender's received-request trace. Private TTL abuse controls; cascades on profile preparation/Auth deletion.

public.gif_verification_limits.excluded: Internal anti-abuse counters (window starts and counts) for GIF verification, not authored content; rows cascade on Auth deletion.

public.giphy_gif_ratings.excluded: GIPHY catalogue metadata (GIF id and its public rating), shared by every player and not tied to any account.

public.leaderboard_rank_observations.excluded: Internal derived daily public-rank observations, retained for 35 days and readable only through permission-checked ranking responses. Not authored content or received correspondence. No direct API table access; rows cascade on account deletion.

public.oauth_pseudo_pending.excluded: Transient OAuth onboarding marker deleted when the username is chosen; the username itself is exported in profile.

public.private_message_reads.excluded: Private read receipts contain counterpart identifiers; manual privacy review, no received correspondence export.

public.private_messages.note: Only messages authored by the requesting player, not entire conversations.

public.pro_access_grants.excluded: Operator attribution and free-text notes require manual privacy review; never expose another account's operator data.

public.profile_media_assets.note: Own allowlisted metadata and sanitized URLs, no storage capabilities.

public.profile_visit_receipts.note: Retained own legacy history; retired feature does not erase exportable history.

public.push_dispatch_config.excluded: Internal global webhook configuration containing a server authentication secret. Not an individual account record; no API access or self-service secret export.

public.push_subscriptions.excluded: Browser push delivery endpoints and encryption/authentication capability material are excluded from automatic downloads, like session credentials. Own device subscriptions can be revoked in settings and cascade on account deletion. Requests concerning these operational records require manual privacy review; this is not a legal exemption.

public.referral_codes.note: Only the requesting player's invitation code and creation date.

public.referrals.note: Own sent/received referral events and reward dates; no counterparty UUID, email, code or profile.

public.signup_email_domain_rules.excluded: Global domain-level allow/block policy copied from a public source. Contains no email addresses, account identifiers or player records. Owner-only data, not an individual account export.

public.trade_offer_submission_limits.excluded: Current anti-abuse admission count/window only; manual security/privacy review, with deletion cascading from the account. No message contents or asset records.

public.user_reports.note: Own submissions only; received reports, free text and snapshots excluded.

public.wall_post_replies.note: Own replies only, including GIF and attachment-presence metadata.

public.wall_reply_media_cleanup.excluded: Internal exact-object cleanup authorization and single-use path fence, not authored content. No API table access; player receipts cascade on Auth deletion. Operator orphan claims have no player identity. Storage paths and capabilities are never exported.

public.wishlist.note: Compatibility view of wishlists, not duplicated in the file.

storage.buckets.excluded: Global storage configuration, not an individual account record.

storage.objects.note: Only own allowlisted file metadata; no binary contents, paths or signed URLs.
